title: H3Remover: Reinforcing Video Object Removal without Paired Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.24633v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pretrained video editors possess rich removal and completion priors, yet may retain targets or alter unrelated content. We present H3Remover, which reinforces MiniMax-H3 Base Ref2VA for video object removal without paired object-free training targets. To discourage superficial edits such as recoloring, a target-removal reward favors calibrated depth changes consistent with revealing farther content. To limit unintended scene changes, a background-geometry reward encourages preservation of relative depth ordering. To preserve background appearance without retaining unwanted shadows or reflections, an appearance reward constrains RGB changes in source-derived protected regions while exempting targets and estimated effects. Frozen HPSv3 complements these constraints with perceptual-quality feedback for synthesized content. Evaluation regions remain fixed across candidates, and DiffusionART optimizes LoRA adapters with the backbone frozen.

translated_title: H3Remover：无需配对数据的视频目标去除强化方法
translated_abstract: 预训练视频编辑器拥有丰富的去除与补全先验，但可能会保留目标或改变无关内容。我们提出H3Remover，它强化MiniMax-H3 Base Ref2VA用于视频目标去除，而无需配对的无目标训练目标。为抑制诸如重新着色等表面编辑，目标去除奖励倾向于与显现更远内容相一致的校准深度变化。为限制意外的场景变化，背景几何奖励鼓励保持相对深度排序。为保持背景外观同时不保留不想要的阴影或反射，外观奖励约束源自源视频的受保护区域中的RGB变化，同时豁免目标及其估计效果。冻结的HPSv3为合成内容提供感知质量反馈，补充了这些约束。评估区域在各候选间保持固定，DiffusionART在主干冻结的情况下优化LoRA适配器。
tldr: H3Remover通过目标去除深度校准、背景几何保持、外观保护等多重奖励并结合冻结的HPSv3感知反馈进行强化学习，在无需配对训练数据的条件下强化预训练视频编辑模型，实现高质量的视频目标去除。
en_tdlr: H3Remover reinforces a pretrained video editor for video object removal without paired training data, using multiple rewards for calibrated depth-based target removal, background geometry preservation, and appearance protection, complemented by frozen HPSv3 perceptual feedback.
